scope: 14 individually reviewed source-verified bottle models; unverified cap and material claims excluded

sports.2312: Model 2312 represents a 1,000 ml sports bottle with catalog dimensions of 7.7 by 29 cm. It is a useful counterpart to 800 ml model 2311, which is listed at 7.7 by 27 cm; the difference in nominal volume and height should be checked against real samples before creating a size-family display. The source records purple-pink, blue-orange, green-pink and gray-black gradients, and names PC, PP and ABS components. It does not confirm that 2312 and 2311 use interchangeable closures or molded parts. Request separate lid and seal close-ups, compare the printed logo panel on the exact assembled bottles, and approve actual colors. OPP bag packing, 60 units per carton and an outer box of 48 by 40 by 58.5 cm are listed; validate freight dimensions independently.

Its source color names correspond to starry black, fantasy pink, aurora purple and moon white, which calls for different artwork proofs than the multicolor gradients used on some neighboring models. The naming describes catalog options, not verified special coatings or visual effects. PC, PP and ABS are listed as materials without an exact cap or sealing specification. A buyer should inspect real samples for color consistency and check whether the artwork remains visible at the chosen print position. The catalog specifies individual OPP bags and 60 pieces per 49.5 by 40.5 by 49.5 cm master carton. Confirm that carton information for the ordered finish.

This makes body proportion, packing width and display footprint especially useful questions for a buyer; it is not proof of any particular handle or cap structure. Purple-green, black-orange and blue-pink gradients are recorded color options. The source names PC, PP and ABS component families but gives no model-specific leakage test or drinking closure detail. Ask for an assembled sample to compare the real footprint, intended logo position and filled-unit balance. This model has mixed frosted drawstring-bag packing with 48 units per 65.5 by 45.5 by 42.5 cm carton, unlike the OPP-bag formats of several sports counterparts. Confirm the actual shipping configuration.

A branded-event buyer comparing these two 800 ml options should measure the finished height including the closure and check the actual printing panel on each sample. PC, PP and ABS appear as component families without a confirmed cap mechanism or food-contact grade breakdown. The source lists individual OPP bags and 60 units in a 59 by 43 by 47 cm master carton. Confirm packed dimensions, any seal components and destination-market evidence before approving procurement.
sports.2516: The 1,000 ml sports model 2516 is recorded at 8.3 by 26.8 cm, a different shape reference from the narrower, taller 1,000 ml model 2514. Distributors selecting a coordinated medium and large hydration range can compare real body proportions and carton usage rather than assume these two bottles share lids or accessories. The source lists gradient blue, pink, black and purple options together with PC, PP and ABS components. It does not identify the drinking opening, sealing arrangement or exact printing area. Request a complete assembled sample, then assess how the approved artwork fits the actual curved wall. A 60-piece master carton measuring 60 by 43 by 55 cm and individual OPP bags are catalog references; verify final packing and shipping volume with the selected variant.

Its documented dimensions are 8.3 by 31 cm, so a procurement team planning retail shelving or event cartons should check standing height and filled weight rather than extrapolate from smaller family models. The materials are cataloged as PC, PP and ABS, not as a certification for the finished drinking assembly. No reliable source description establishes an exact straw, flip-top or screw-cap system. Ask for photos of the full lid and any removable seal, plus a production sample with the intended logo. The record lists OPP bag packing and 60 pieces per 60 by 45 by 55 cm master carton.
